source.title: National Aeronautics and Space Administration section (Table-5 cap-fit unit, page 20). Full 9-column outlays model. Self-contained: no cell overlaps another unit's table. Family pattern: plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md.
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' -- omitted (Proprietary and Total This-Month Applicable/Outlays). Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Full visual render and cid-decoded text-layer cross-check completed for page 20. Current/Prior Applicable columns each have one printed source, so their line-level Proprietary cells are standalone and the total cells are covered by total-row identities. Six gross/net column roll-ups plus two total-row identities are the honest structural maximum (8 relations); the provisional manifest floor was corrected from 9 to 8 before transcription. Four relations require tol 1 under the printed rounding note.

cells.why: Applicable Receipts on 'Proprietary Receipts from the Public', a line with no Gross Outlays (Gross column '......'): Outlays(net) = -Applicable, but the offset has no Gross cell to target and Proprietary is the only printed Applicable source in this period (single-source column, no >=2-source roll-up). Relation-free within this unit; the section-total Applicable cell is covered by the total-row net identity.

Applicable Receipts on 'Proprietary Receipts from the Public', a line with no Gross Outlays (Gross column '......'): Outlays(net) = -Applicable, but the offset has no Gross cell to target and Proprietary is the only printed Applicable source in this period (single-source column, no >=2-source roll-up). Relation-free within this unit; the section-total Applicable cell is covered by the total-row net identity.
